9 packages · MIT · 58 installs across the fleet

The trunk.

The trunk every product above grows from. Nine packages, MIT, on npm or GitHub — and each one lists exactly which apps use it, so you can see what a change would touch before you make it.

Adopter lists are derived from real package.json files across the organisation by fleet's registry audit — nobody types them, and a package that quietly lost its last user would show it here.

bitbaum is built in Zürich, in the open. Nothing here is registered; an orangecat.ch name is an address on one server.
